# Lorenzo Niccoli | Personal Website

This repository contains the source code for my personal website.

## Live Site
The site is deployed at: [lorenzoniccoli.github.io](https://github.io)

## Technical Architecture
*   **Static Site Generator:** Jekyll
*   **Hosting:** GitHub Pages
*   **Content Management:** Markdown and Liquid templates

## Project Structure
*   `cv.md`: Professional background and experience.
*   `publications.md`: Reasearch paper collection.
*   `photos.md`: Pictures I took while traveling.

## Local Development
To build and preview the site locally, execute the following commands in the project root:

```bash
bundle install
bundle exec jekyll serve
```
The local server will be accessible at `http://localhost:4000`.
